mentions.name: Eli5 Equations
mentions.description: This app uses an LLM (Gemini) to convert a picture of an equation to LaTeX and, when given additional context, breaks down the equation's parts to explain it.
mentions.source_excerpt: 1. Eli5 equations(2) uses an LLM to convert a given picture of an equation to latex and, if given additional context, breaks down the equation parts to explain it. Gemini for the model.
